KYC_BANK_FRAUD.name: Bank & KYC Suspension Scam
KYC_BANK_FRAUD.description: Fraudulent notice threatening account freeze or suspension unless KYC is updated via an unofficial link or APK.
advice: Never update KYC through SMS/WhatsApp links. Official banks never ask for credentials via chat.
Log in directly to your bank's official app or netbanking portal.
Report the SMS/number to 1930 (Cyber Crime Helpline) or your bank's fraud reporting line.

OTP_CREDENTIAL_PHISHING.name: OTP & Credential Phishing
OTP_CREDENTIAL_PHISHING.description: Attempt to harvest One-Time Passwords (OTP), 2FA codes, PINs, or banking passwords.
advice: NEVER share OTPs or verification codes with anyone, not even bank employees.
Remember: You NEVER need to enter a UPI PIN to receive money.
If you entered your PIN or OTP on a suspicious page, freeze your account immediately.

LOTTERY_PRIZE_SCAM.name: Lottery & Prize Scam
LOTTERY_PRIZE_SCAM.description: Unsolicited claims of winning massive cash prizes, luxury cars, iPhones, or lucky draws requiring fees or link clicks.
advice: Legitimate lotteries do not ask for advance processing fees or WhatsApp forwards.
If you did not enter a contest, you cannot have won it.
Do not click promotional links or call unverified phone numbers.

FAKE_JOB_TASK_SCAM.name: Fake Job & Work-From-Home Task Scam
FAKE_JOB_TASK_SCAM.description: Offers of easy part-time work, liking YouTube videos, Google Maps reviews, or Telegram tasks promising exorbitant daily income.
advice: Genuine employers never hire without interviews or ask candidates to pay prepaid deposits.
Prepaid task schemes ('pay ₹1,000 to unlock ₹5,000 commission') are 100% Ponzi scams.
Refuse to join unofficial Telegram task groups.

INVESTMENT_CRYPTO_SCAM.name: Guaranteed Investment & Crypto Scam
INVESTMENT_CRYPTO_SCAM.description: Promises of unrealistic guaranteed returns, crypto doubling schemes, insider stock tips, or forex trading bots.
advice: All legitimate investments carry risk. Any promise of 'guaranteed high returns' is fraudulent.
Verify broker registration with financial regulators (e.g., SEBI, SEC, FCA).
Never transfer cryptocurrency or funds to unknown individuals or unverified apps.

DELIVERY_PARCEL_IMPERSONATION.name: Courier & Delivery Impersonation
DELIVERY_PARCEL_IMPERSONATION.description: Fake messages from postal or courier services claiming package address is incomplete or unpaid customs duties are owed.
advice: Do not click delivery links sent via SMS/WhatsApp. Check tracking on the official courier portal.
Couriers do not ask for card details via random shortlinks to update addresses.
Inspect sender number; automated notifications typically come from branded SMS sender IDs.

VIRAL_FORWARD_CHAIN.name: Viral Forwarding Chain / Social Engineering
VIRAL_FORWARD_CHAIN.description: Emotional or fear-mongering messages urging the recipient to forward to 10-20 contacts to avoid penalties or claim perks.
advice: Forwarding chains are almost universally fake or intended to distribute spam.
WhatsApp remains free; official updates are communicated through the app store, not forwarded chains.
Stop the viral spread: Do not forward unverified claims.
